name: app-6aa17df6d31c8191bc4dfe3acc523086
description: Find RVs, camper vans, and travel trailers to rent on Outdoorsy. Search by destination, trip dates, sleeping capacity, and amenities; explore listing details; check availability; and compare price quotes. Explore host add-ons, delivery estimates, and potential savings from a longer stay. Get answers from Outdoorsy’s renter FAQ and help center, then follow a listing link to complete your booking on Outdoorsy.

interface.longDescription: Find RVs, camper vans, and travel trailers to rent on Outdoorsy. Search by destination, trip dates, sleeping capacity, and amenities; explore listing details; check availability; and compare price quotes. Explore host add-ons, delivery estimates, and potential savings from a longer stay. Get answers from Outdoorsy’s renter FAQ and help center, then follow a listing link to complete your booking on Outdoorsy.

positive.description: Discover suitable RV rentals and inspect a returned listing.
positive.prompt: Find up to five drivable RVs near Denver for four people, June 10–17, 2027. We cannot tow. Show me the details of one matching option.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching RV listings with photos and links, then details for one returned listing using its actual identifier and the requested dates; reports no matches honestly if inventory is unavailable.

positive.description: Compare quotes without requiring pickup or return times.
positive.prompt: Find two drivable RVs near Austin that sleep two for May 10–14, 2027, and compare their full price quotes. Use the hosts’ default pickup and return times.
positive.expected_behavior: Compares up to two returned rentals for the same dates, showing available totals, fees, deposits, payment schedules, and dated listing links; explains partial or missing results without inventing prices.

positive.description: Check availability, quote a longer stay, and explore rental-rate savings.
positive.prompt: Find a drivable RV near Phoenix for two people for November 10–16, 2027. Check one matching RV’s availability, give me a full quote, and see whether extending the stay could improve the rental rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports availability and minimum-stay constraints, returns a quote using default times, and mentions an extension only if a qualifying offer exists; distinguishes rental-rate estimates from final trip totals and does not claim extended dates are available without checking.

positive.description: Inspect add-ons and quote explicitly requested delivery.
positive.prompt: Find an RV that sleeps four and offers delivery near Austin for April 12–16, 2027. For one matching RV, show me its details and available add-ons, then quote delivery to McKinney Falls State Park in Austin. Do not add any extras yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists actual host extras and requests a delivery quote only for a suitable listing; geocodes the supplied public destination and reports the delivery fee if returned, or explains an address or delivery-radius error without claiming delivery is free; makes no booking.

positive.description: Route marketplace mechanics and policy questions to the appropriate sources.
positive.prompt: How does renting an RV on Outdoorsy work, and what are the current rules for pets and cancellation?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the curated renter FAQ for the rental process and current help-center articles for pet and cancellation policies; grounds answers in returned content, links relevant articles, and acknowledges listing-specific rules or missing information.

negative.description: RV purchases are outside the rental marketplace.
negative.prompt: Find a used Airstream I can buy for under $60,000.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Outdoorsy tools; explains that this app supports RV trip rentals rather than vehicle sales.

negative.description: Campsite-only reservations are outside this RV surface.
negative.prompt: Book a tent campsite at Zion National Park. I already have camping gear and do not need an RV.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Outdoorsy tools or imply it can reserve campsites; explains that this app finds RV rentals.

negative.description: Existing reservation changes require account support outside the app.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing Outdoorsy reservation and refund my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke the discovery tools to cancel or refund a reservation, request payment credentials, or claim a change was made; directs the renter to manage the booking on Outdoorsy or contact support.

review.commerce_description: Renters follow listing links to complete bookings and payment on Outdoorsy. The plugin does not create bookings or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with RV rental search, listing details, availability, price comparisons, add-ons, and renter help.
